prompt.description: Optional text prompt for precise control of the scene, movements and camera. Supported languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish (Mexican) and Indonesian.
prompt.title: Prompt

audio_url.description: The URL of the audio file to generate the video. Format: wav or mp3. Max size: 15 MB. Duration between 4 and 300 seconds.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

image_url.description: The URL of the image used to generate the video. Format: jpeg, png, webp, bmp, tiff, gif, heic or heif. Max size: 30 MB. Aspect ratio (width/height) between 0.4 and 2.5; width and height between 300 and 6000 pixels.
image_url.title: Image Url

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

duration.description: Duration of audio input/video output as used for billing.
duration.title: Duration
